scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.demo: python -m scraper.demo --output data/demo && npm run import -- data/demo/dataset.json
scripts.types: npm run types --prefix backend && npm run types --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && python -m unittest discover -s scraper/tests
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
